name: The Princess Carriage
description: Princess carriage, a means of transportation used by Western nobles, is gorgeous in shape, noble and elegant, and is known as the "palace on wheels". It is a symbol of solemnity, power and wealth. In British royal weddings, carriage tours around the city have always been a tradition, and the prince and princess will receive blessings from the public in the carriage. Carriages often appear in fairy tales and are a symbol of romance and happiness. Every girl hopes to become a princess in fairy tales and meet Cinderella in a carriage.
